points: 0 of your 5 written ads carry a proof number, so buyers have nothing to weigh against the price. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
10 of your 15 ads are feed ads with no story, so a cold buyer has no reason to stop scrolling. Build three story ads around one product, such as the Makita Makpac case, and show it in use.
6 of your 7 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the tool in the ad, so the click has to search. Point each one to the product it shows, so buyers land on the item they clicked.
Your offers only appear in the Click Days and Makita ads, so a first time buyer on the other ads has no reason to act today. Open three new ads with a first order offer and print it on the creative.
